environment: Windows 11 Pro x64, MSVC 19.51, GNS 1.6.1 and OpenSSL 3.6.5 via vcpkg 65a2c23, loopback; real time
game_exe_sha256: N/A (prototype does not touch the game)
objective: Implement ChatGPT review #15 (FB-15-01..05) on feature/review15-followup: verify GNS return routability from source, investigate KI-42 and KI-40, run the predeclared GNS-only DTLS cookie A/B with negative security tests, and validate the head with the full v6 battery.
hypothesis: On GNS, whose return routability is verified from source (F-GNS-001/002), skipping our DTLS cookie removes one RTT per secure reconnect and lowers the median harsh-gns-secure recovery by at least 10% without weakening identity, the invitation binding or bounded pending state.
procedure: Verified GNS address-bound dispatch from source (F-GNS-002). Added capability proves_return_routability (GNS true) and host flag --dtls-skip-cookie-if-routable (off by default); security tests secure_cookie_skip_never_weakens_identity_or_udp and secure_cookie_skip_keeps_pending_state_bounded. KI-42: MORDOR_GNS_TRACE lifecycle trace, unrouted-callback counter, endpoint-reuse stress test (3 teardown orders). KI-40: dumped two hangs with cdb -pv; fix gns_shutdown_for_exit() at the end of the test runner, host and client, with a regression test. Wait-Bounded process waits with exit_status; run.json records the effective skip. Predeclared EXP-027 in docs/soak-testing.md, committed in bd052d6 before its runs. On bd052d6, each step in its own process with hang-watch.ps1: suites on both builds x2, E2E, asymmetric x4, secure E2E x4, EXP-027 (harsh-gns-secure, A cookie / B skip, 10 per arm interleaved, seed bases 600..690 recorded but not effective on GNS), 12-scenario battery + 4 repeats per harsh secure profile (seeds 710..740).
expected_result: B adopted for GNS; suites, E2E and the battery pass.
observed_result: EXP-027 (rule as predeclared, compare_arms.py --arm skip_cookie_if_routable): A median 1992 max 4407 ms, 3 over 3000 ms; B median 2274 max 3057 ms, 1 over 3000 ms; no aborted run among the 20 counted; no other gate failure. Condition 2 failed (B median 14% higher): B not adopted. The skip took effect (B hosts hello_verify_sent 0, cookie_skipped 3; A hosts sent HelloVerifyRequests) and the DTLS phase p50/p90 fell from 613/822 to 413/631 ms, about one RTT; the total did not follow (the establishment and session phases vary more). The first EXP-027 run (023741) was cut at 1.5 s when the runner was killed by a session restart; kept, not counted. Security tests passed. KI-42: 540 stress rounds, 0 misses; every unrouted callback explained as benign. KI-40: root cause is GNS's own atexit handler waiting on a lock held by the terminated service thread; after the fix 15/15 transport-suite runs exited (before: 2 hangs in 6). Suites: both passes all passed on both builds, transport check OK. E2E, asymmetric 4/4, secure E2E 4/4 passed. Battery 12/12 and repeats 8/8 passed; every process exited by itself. Pooled default policy at bd052d6: harsh-gns-secure 3/15, harsh-udp-secure 0/5 over 3000 ms. Hang watcher: no stuck process.
errors: Hypothesis rejected: the cookie skip saved one RTT in the DTLS phase but did not lower the median recovery. KI-35 open; KI-42 not reproduced.
follow_up: KI-35 on GNS: GNS connection establishment under loss and the session phase dominate the variance; a 200 ms effect needs far more than 10 runs per arm. KI-42 stays instrumented. KI-28b; LAN test; external security review.
